text: Hey 🌷 If you are on A5, you register the baby in the hospital but they give you a temporary id number. With it then you go to the misrad hapnim and they give you the permanent one plus the birth certificate. As soon as you get that, you can register the baby at the kupat holim.  To Tipat haliav you can go even with the temporary number. About the passport, I think you need an appointment but you can may be try getting it while there for the birth certificate ( I doubt it but you can always ask 🤞 ). Good luck and mazal tov ❤️
